name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The project hosts a mineral reserve of approximately 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold, with a larger measured and indicated resource base of ~186 Moz silver and 1.6 Moz gold. The company has received environmental approvals and RIGI large-investment program designation, and is advancing toward a construction decision.
